result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: overlapping/garbled delivery info text under Tokumaru Ramen Bar in the Popular right now section.

issues.description: The metadata line below 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows garbled overlapping text reading as '25-30rdelivery' where delivery time and delivery fee appear to collide on top of each other, making it unreadable.
